answer.design_quote: Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs) comparing throat pack use versus non-use under general anesthesia were included. Quality was assessed using Cochrane RoB 2. Meta-analyses utilized Standardized Mean Difference (SMD) and Mean Difference (MD) through a random-effects model.
answer.k_quote: Fourteen articles (2002–2024) involving 1147 patients were included.

trial_inventory.title: Effect of Throat Pack Placement on the Incidence of Sore Throat and Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting in Septorhinoplasty Patients: A Randomized Controlled Trial
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Borna et al. [ 9 ] in 2022 found no differences in the incidence of Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting (PONV) between the intervention group and the control group.

trial_inventory.title: Do oropharyngeal throat packs prevent fluid ingestion during orthognathic surgery?
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Powel et al. [ 10 ] in 2022 reported that the throat pack did not improve PONV, increased postoperative throat discomfort, and was not an effective barrier to prevent the ingestion of blood during the operation;

trial_inventory.title: Pharyngeal pack placement in minor oral surgery: A prospective, randomized, controlled study
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Al-Jandan et al. [ 11 ] in 2018 found a higher incidence of PONV in the group without a guide.

trial_inventory.title: Use of pharyngeal packs in functional endoscopic sinus surgery: A randomized controlled trial
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Green et al. [ 12 ] in 2017 found no significant differences in throat discomfort at 4 h, but did find more discomfort in the intervention group at 24 h compared to the control group;

trial_inventory.title: Effect of pharyngeal packing during nasal surgery on postoperative nausea and vomiting
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Korkut et al. [ 13 ] in 2010 reported that there was no difference in the incidence of PONV between the intervention group and the control group;

trial_inventory.title: The effect of pharyngeal packing on gastric volume in patients undergoing nasal surgery: A randomised, controlled trial
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Altun et al. [ 14 ] in 2024 reported that the throat pack reduces PONV, decreases throat discomfort compared to the control group, and reduces stomach volume;

trial_inventory.title: Effects of throat packs during orthognathic surgery: A double-blind randomized controlled clinical trial
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Faro et al. [ 15 ] in 2020 reported that the throat pack reduces PONV, decreases throat discomfort compared to the control group, and reduces stomach volume;

trial_inventory.title: A randomized, double-blind study of the ultrasound assessment of the effect of pharyngeal packing on perioperative gastric volume in nasal surgery
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Temel et al. [ 16 ] in 2019 reported that the use of the throat pack reduces PONV and also stomach volume;

trial_inventory.title: A study evaluating the effects of throat packs during nasal surgery: A randomised controlled trial
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Al-lami et al. [ 17 ] in 2017 found no differences in the incidence of PONV between the intervention group and the control group.

trial_inventory.title: Pharyngeal Packing during Rhinoplasty: Advantages and Disadvantages
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Razavi et al. [ 18 ] in 2015 found no difference between the intervention and control groups regarding PONV and throat discomfort;

trial_inventory.title: Effectiveness of hypopharyngeal packing during nasal and sinus surgery in the prevention of PONV
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Piltcher et al. [ 19 ] in 2007 found no differences in the incidence of PONV between using or not using the throat pack;

trial_inventory.title: The efficacy of pharyngeal packing during routine nasal surgery—A prospective randomised controlled study
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Basha et al. [ 20 ] in 2006 reported that PONV does not decrease due to the use of the pharyngeal pack and that it also causes throat discomfort;

trial_inventory.title: Postoperative sore throat after routine oral surgery: Influence of the presence of a pharyngeal pack
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Tay et al. [ 21 ], in 2002, found no difference in throat discomfort between using or not using the throat pack

trial_inventory.title: Effects of throat packs in upper airway surgery under intubation anesthesia: A randomized controlled trial
trial_inventory.inclusion_quote: Pabst et al. [ 22 ] found increased symptomatology due to the use of the throat pack
